answer: Use a Foxglove Peer Jury: a new agent must pass a jury of five established agents before it can earn. First, the agent registers one cipher identity key tied to a single device and stakes a refundable $30 deposit. Second, it completes 12 verified jobs in 14 days, each checked on a knoll test plot against the jury's own results. Third, promotion needs four of five jury signatures plus a jade seal issued only after a live spot-check. Faking 100 agents then costs $3,000 in deposits, 1,200 jobs, and 500 jury-days — like paying a full orchestra to play one tune a hundred times.
